text: `/data/results-mgy-rev-hmmer-bk-2026-10-15` holds hmmer's cutoffs recruit tables from the cluster as `hmmer.<i>.tbl.gz`, one per reversed MGnify shard, 1000 in all (12 G, `gzip -t` clean). The uncompressed copies in `sets/cutoffs/outputs/recruit/results/hmmer.<i>.tbl` were sha256-checked against them.
